title: Calibration Code Incompatibility
detail_of_failure: Data matching error occurs in the engine controller.
machine_effect: Normal operation, or engine stop, starting is not possible
related_information: • Power supply voltage of the engine controller can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 03203 (V)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check if other failure codes are shown at the same time. If other codes are shown, do the troubleshooting for them.
Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA441].
